title: Initiative funnel: stability forecast driverboard and automatic prioritization
creator: Maya Ortiz
description: Build an 'initiative funnel' driverboard that converts realtime SLI deviations and error-budget burn projections into prioritized roadmap recommendations and gated rollouts. The driverboard should synthesize telemetry (SLI variance, burn rate, incident frequency), Monte Carlo forecasts, and product OKR weightings to produce a ranked list of candidate reliability initiatives and suggested action windows.
acceptance_criteria: Driverboard UI that accepts SLI targets and weightings and shows top-10 initiative recommendations with score breakdown
Automated pipeline that pulls SLI/SLO metrics and computes burn-rate forecasts (Monte Carlo) hourly
Integration with product backlog: recommended initiatives create draft PM tickets with suggested scope/estimate via API
Gate rules that can pin/cancel planned rollouts when projected error-budget exhaustion crosses thresholds
Proof-of-concept run in staging showing at least 3 historical incidents re-prioritized correctly by the driverboard
tasks: Design scoring model (SLI variance, burn acceleration factor, OKR alignment) — PM lead
Data work: build ETL for SLI timeseries and incident metadata — ENG
Forecast service: implement Monte Carlo simulator with configurable horizons — ENG
UI: lightweight driverboard prototype in Console with filter by team/region/model — Design + FE
Backlog integration: API hook to create draft PM issues with template — Platform
Add opt-in gating rules and rollback suggestions to rollout orchestration — ENG
Run retrospective simulation on last 6 months to validate recommendations — PM/Eng
